text:
maria: Heads-up: the new onboarding sample (embed-bulk-runner) is getting smacked by 429s on first warmup when users set batchSize=64 + concurrency=12. Repro on latest js-sdk.

kevin: Can you share a short trace? is it token-rate or concurrency?

maria: quick trace: we dispatch 12 parallel POSTs at t=0, edge returns 429s with Retry-After ~2s starting at t=1s, clients backoff and then many retry almost simultaneously -> another wave of 429s.

sam: that smells like synchronized retries + poor queue accounting. The sample app default was tuned for speed.

maria: sample config snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, maxConcurrency: 12, retry: { maxAttempts: 6 } });
await client.embeddings.bulkCreate({ inputChunks, batchSize: 64 });
```

leo: devx-bot: filed DX-912 "onboard bulk embeddings: retry storms + parity fixes" and assigned to @kevin
devx-bot: DX-912 created: https://redwood/devx/912

kevin: immediate thoughts: (1) JS SDK doesn't honor Retry-After header for bulkCreate (we only special-cased chat). (2) backoff uses limited jitter for bulk endpoints. (3) we allow acquiring concurrency slots without token-estimate, so queued bursts spin up when threads clear.

sam: parity problem across SDKs? iOS/Android/Go behave differently?

maria: iOS honored Retry-After but had a small semaphore (concurrency 4) so fewer retries; Android ignored Retry-After but had jitter, so mixed user experience. We need consistent semantics: honor Retry-After, use full jittered exponential backoff, and do token-estimate at queue time.

kevin: action items:
- SDK (js): honor Retry-After for all bulk/embeds endpoints, not just chat.
- SDK: switch to full jitter (sleep = random_between(0, base * 2^attempt)) for bulk endpoints.
- SDK: change semaphore logic to decrement based on estimateTokens(items) when acquiring slot.
- Sample app: lower onboarding defaults (concurrency 3, batchSize 24) and set RW_ONBOARDING_FAST for opt-in.
- Tests: add e2e with fake-rate-limit server that returns Retry-After to verify honor and jitter spread.

sam: i'll prepare a tiny sample-app PR showing conservative defaults + an env flag for power users.

kevin: i'll draft the SDK PR and include changelog note. Also add a unit to ensure we parse Retry-After in seconds and HTTP-date formats.

maria: note: we should teach the console quickstart to recommend "warmup mode" for new accounts that runs with conservative throttle until X tokens consumed. I'll add a short doc blurb.

leo: can we add a debug trace header in the SDK request for onboarding so we can correlate client concurrency with server 429s? maybe X-RW-Client-Semaphore:12

kevin: ok will add X-RW-Client-Slots header (only in debug builds) so infra can map client bursts to edge alarms without PII.

maria: follow-up: after reducing concurrency locally and enabling jitter, I reproed again and saw retries spread over 6s window and no second-wave 429s. Looks promising.

sam: parity checklist for DX-912: JS/Go/Android/iOS -> honor Retry-After, full jitter backoff, token-estimate semaphore. I'll add to ticket body.

maria: leaving notes: devs hit this primarily on bulk onboarding uploads and demo data generators. Recommend we update quickstart and sample repos.

kevin: ping me for review on SDK PRs. I'll include e2e harness and a short change note for release.

maria: thanks all. If anyone hits similar while testing, set DEBUG=sdk:throttle and paste logs here. :raised_hands:
